_note: Approvals for the automatic import after a deploy (what a person would tick on the Import screen). Every warning class needs a reason; every large change needs its record ID in large; missing records need a decision in missing (ID: removed_from_game, draft or ignore).

warnings.community_required: Seed data from the community Fandom wiki (owner decision 2026-10-23: Fish It! lean section on wiki data, no in-game checks asked of Ali). Values show 'Source: community wiki'.
warnings.meta_missing: The wiki gives no reliable update schedule and the game has no confirmed code box, so the hub leaves those facts out.
warnings.outlier: Event and quest items sit far from shop items of the same rarity; values match the wiki tables.
warnings.rarity_order: Rarity does not track price or stats closely for quest, event and Robux items; values match the wiki tables.
